items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Dave Bailey on the drum. That fella played bass drum, a jumper, a Nickerson band.

ctx.x: Yeah, I got his cord in my pocket. I thought he died. No, man. Huh. Did he have a good drum, Chris, regular?
Chris Kelly? Yeah. Yeah. Dave Bailey on the drum. That fella played bass drum, a jumper, a Nickerson band.
